resources.styles_what: QS tile ACTIVE / INACTIVE fill color, resolved in theme Theme.SystemUI.QuickSettings (res/values/styles.xml:553-554) to @androidprv:color/customColorShadeActive / customColorShadeInactive [F]
resources.metro_target: Flat Metro tile: active = accent (cyan #0078D7-class), inactive = neutral #E6E6E6/#1F1F1F instead of tonal Material surfaces

resources.styles_what: Foreground (icon/label) color on active and inactive tiles; consumed by qs_tile_label secondary label and tile icon tint [F]
resources.metro_target: High-contrast label/icon: white on accent, near-black on light inactive — Metro avoids tonal contrast

resources.styles_what: The whole tile chrome: ripple color, mask, base layer + overlay layer, all pointing at qs_tile_background_shape [F]
resources.metro_target: Replace with square gradient-free rect (radius 0 or 2dp), no ripple ring; single flat fill

resources.styles_what: <corners android:radius="@dimen/qs_corner_radius"/> + solid #FFFFFF tinted at runtime by setColor() in QSTileViewImpl [F]
resources.metro_target: THE single best tile-shape hook: set radius to 0dp → all tiles become Metro squares without touching code

resources.styles_what: 28dp — corner radius of every QS tile, referenced by qs_tile_background_shape [F]
resources.metro_target: 0dp (square) or 2dp (slight Metro bevel)

resources.styles_what: 80dp tile height, 12dp inner padding, 16dp start padding, 8dp horizontal gap — read in QSTileViewImpl.kt:238-242,279-292 [F]
resources.metro_target: Metro tiles are wider/shorter: height 64dp, gap 4dp, padding 8dp

resources.styles_what: textSize @dimen/qs_tile_text_size (14sp, dimens.xml:767), letterSpacing .01, lineHeight 20sp, fontFamily config_bodyFontFamilyMedium [F]
resources.metro_target: Metro Segoe-like: textSize 12sp, letterSpacing 0, fontFamily = injected Metro font, textAllCaps=false, single line

resources.styles_what: Secondary (app) label under tile label, regular weight, color ?attr/onShadeInactive (qs_tile_label.xml:56) [F]
resources.metro_target: Hide (visibility gone) or 10sp grey — Metro tiles have no secondary line

resources.styles_what: The label column inflated by QSTileViewImpl.kt:305: IgnorableChildLinearLayout containing @id/tile_label and @id/app_label with textAppearance [F]
resources.metro_target: Restyle in place (padding/margins); Metro wants label bottom-left, icon top-left

resources.styles_what: 28dp / 4dp — radius used when NotificationBackgroundView draws the card background [F: dimens; E: exact consumer line]
resources.metro_target: 0dp — Metro notification cards are square with a 1dp border, not rounded

resources.styles_what: #ff1a1a1a — opaque fallback card fill when no themed background is set [F]
resources.metro_target: Light #FFFFFF / dark #1F1F1F card + 1dp #CCCCCC border (Metro 'tile' look)

resources.styles_what: Colors painted by ScrimView (super_notification_shade.xml: scrim_behind, scrim_notifications) to form the shade/panel background — there is no single 'shade background drawable' [F]
resources.metro_target: Metro shade = solid dark #1F1F1F (or accent) fully opaque, zero blur: this is the panel-background hook

resources.styles_what: 46dp rounded corners of the floating shade panel (lineage-23.2 shade is the 2025 surface design) [F]
resources.metro_target: 0dp — Metro has no rounded panel

resources.styles_what: 600dp max width / 0dp side margin for the floating shade on wide screens [F]
resources.metro_target: Full-bleed panel (600dp → match_parent) for the Metro 'everything is a plane' look

resources.styles_what: Expanded-shade clock: textSize @dimen/qs_time_expanded_size (14sp, dimens.xml:966), config_headlineFontFamilyMedium, textColorPrimary [F]
resources.metro_target: Metro header clock is thin-large: 28sp, fontFamily config_bodyFontFamily (light), letterSpacing -0.02

resources.styles_what: Shade header typography (status/build/clock) with feature-flag font families ('variable-display-small-emphasized'), color @color/shade_header_text_color [F]
resources.metro_target: Pin all three to the injected Metro font + fixed sizes, bypassing the variable-font feature flags

resources.styles_what: 14sp shade header text, 14sp status-bar clock [F]
resources.metro_target: Metro: 12sp status clock, 16sp header meta text

resources.styles_what: Header row min height chains to @dimen/status_bar_height (784); system-icons row height (619) [F]
resources.metro_target: Compact Metro header: 48dp row, icons right-aligned

resources.styles_what: 24dp (AOSP android-16.0.0_r3); SystemUI's status_bar_padding_start/top (res/values/dimens.xml:463, 469) add the insets [F]
resources.metro_target: Status bar stays 24dp; Metro look comes from typography + icon set, not height — changing height shifts all insets and is the riskiest dimension to overlay

resources.styles_what: notification_panel background is @android:color/transparent (line 26) — the visible shade is painted by the ScrimViews behind it [F]
resources.metro_target: Restyle the scrim colors, do not try to overlay a 'panel background' that does not exist

resources.styles_what: Shade window root (NotificationShadeWindowView): communal_ui_stub, scrim_behind, scrim_notifications, status_bar_expanded, light_reveal_scrim, keyguard_root_view, shared_notification_container [F]
resources.metro_target: Do NOT overlay this layout — it is the window root; restyle children/colors instead

resources.styles_what: Keyguard top bar, bottom shortcut/indication area, and the AOSP multi-shade container [F: files exist]
resources.metro_target: Metro lock screen: keep layout, restyle the clock (TextAppearance.StatusBar.Expanded.Clock) and bottom areas
